name: Oloric v0.1 Training Dataset
description: Audited 480-example dataset for Oloric v0.1 QLoRA fine-tuning. This is the authoritative training dataset for the first Oloric training run.
notes: This file is committed to Git and must not be regenerated.
The SHA-256 hash is the authoritative integrity check.
Verified on Antigravity dev environment before push.
warmup_ratio in configs is read by training.py and converted to warmup_steps (Transformers 5.x compatibility).
